experiment.name: hf_patchtst_revin_no_volume_lrschedule
experiment.description: hf_patchtst_revin_no_volume (step 4) + a cosine-annealing LR schedule (6e-4 -> 6e-6 over 20 epochs), no warmup. Everything else identical to step 4 (same architecture, same plain RevIN MSE loss, no directional term) -- tests whether letting the optimizer settle more precisely in later epochs, instead of training at a flat 6e-4 the whole time, improves RMSE/directional accuracy/coherence over step 4's baseline.

loss_weights.note: unweighted -- single RevIN-normalized MSE over the 4 OHLC channels
